decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 1 Sutton Road, Hounslow.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side (eastern) elevation of the side extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any side wall of the extension or the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The side wall hereby approved shall have a metal grille, with the upright bars spaced not less than 10 cm apart and the space between the bars shall not be filled in, adjacent to the new sliding gate as shown in 'Elevation 5' on drawing number 835-P02B.  The metal gate shall be in the form of an open grille with the bars spaced not less than 10 cm apart and the space between the bars shall not be filled in

Condition : 7 - The garage and brick wall hereby approved shall be build in red bricks to match those used on the front wall of the house at 1 Sutton Road (apart from the top course of bricks of the wall as specified in the approved drawings), and the roof of the garage shall be in red roofing tiles

Condition : 8 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used as a garage or for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 1 Sutton Road, Hounslow and shall be used for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities).
description: Erection of a ground floor side extension and a new boundary wall and single storey outbuilding in the rear garden for use as a garage.
